title: DocumentDataSource
description:
Document generation data source for producing documents from templates and table data.
Implements ITableDataSource and IParametrizedDataSource<TableDataSourceParameter>.
Enables generation of PDFs, Word documents, or other file formats by merging template definitions
with data from database tables. Supports field mapping from source data to template placeholders,
custom content/filename columns, and parameterized queries.

name.description: Gets the unique name identifier for this document data source. Used in component bindings.

templateName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the document template to use for generation.
The template defines the document structure, formatting, and placeholder definitions.
Example: "InvoiceTemplate", "CertificateTemplate".

contentColumnName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the database column containing the generated document content.
This is the field in the result that holds the actual document bytes or content.
Example: "DocumentContent", "FileData".

contentTypeColumnName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the database column containing the document content type/MIME type.
Example: "application/pdf", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document".

fileNameColumn.description:
Gets or sets the name of the database column containing the generated file name.
Used to determine the downloaded filename when the document is returned to the client.
Example: "Invoice_2024_001.pdf".

isFileContentResult.description:
Gets or sets whether the result should be treated as raw file content.
When true, the response bypasses normal component processing and returns file download.

url.description:
Gets or sets the optional URL where the generated document can be accessed.
Used when documents are stored externally and referenced rather than returned inline.
Example: "https://documents.example.gov/files/invoice-12345.pdf".

parameters.description:
Gets or sets the list of table parameters that provide runtime values for the document query.
Parameters define how component state or user claims are passed to the data source.

mappings.description:
Gets or sets the field mappings that define how source data columns are mapped to template placeholders.
Maps source field names from the database query to template placeholder names.
Example: source "EmployeeFirstName" → template placeholder "FirstName".

type.description: Gets the data source type. Always DataSourceType.Document.

singleResult.description:
Gets or sets whether this document source returns a single document rather than a collection.
When true, a single document is generated. When false, multiple documents may be generated.

allowUnauthorizedAccess.description:
Gets or sets whether this document source allows unauthenticated access.
When true, document generation proceeds without requiring authentication.

tableName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the database table or view that provides data for the document.
The query against this table is filtered by the parameters and used to populate the template.

viewName.description:
Gets or sets the named view configuration for the document source table.
Views can customize filtering or structure of the data provided to templates.

forwardPaginationParameters.description:
Gets or sets whether pagination parameters should be forwarded to the document query.
Rarely used for single documents, but may support bulk document generation.

allOf.description:
Defines a table data source parameter for database table queries.
Extends DataSourceParameterBase with IsRequired flag and TableParameterDestinationType to determine
whether the parameter serves as a filter, search condition, or query parameter.

isRequired.description:
Gets or sets whether this parameter is required by the table query.
When true, the parameter value must be provided or the query will fail.
When false, the query can execute without this parameter if not available in component state.

type.description:
Gets or sets how this parameter is applied to the table data source.
Values: TableFilter (typed search-form condition — LIKE '%v%' on a Text field),
TableSearch (exact match — = value, or IN when the value has commas), or Query (direct SQL parameter).
Default is TableFilter. Determines the SQL generation strategy used by the data source executor.

TableParameterDestinationType.description:
Specifies how a table parameter is applied when querying a database table or view.
JSON serialized as string values. Determines the SQL generation strategy used by the executor.

DataSourceParameterBase.description:
Base class for all data source parameter definitions.
Parameters define how external values (component state, user claims, pagination info) map to data source inputs.
Supports token substitution: ${componentName}, ${item.field}, ${User.attribute}, ~UserID, ~NOW.

sourceName.description:
Gets or sets the source location of the parameter value. Required.
Examples: component name, nested path (item.field), claim name.
Supports token syntax like "${itemValue}", "${User.Id}", "~UserID", "~NOW".

destinationName.description:
Gets or sets the destination name for this parameter in the data source.
For API parameters: the OpenAPI parameter name.
For SQL parameters: the SQL parameter name (with or without @ prefix).
For Table parameters: the filter/search/query field name.
If not specified, defaults to the SourceName.

DataSourceMapping.description:
Defines a field mapping for document data sources.
Maps source field names from database query results to target field names in document templates.

sourceFieldName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the source field in the database query result.
This is the field name returned by the SQL query against the document's source table.
Example: "EmployeeFirstName", "ApprovalDate", "DocumentAmount".

targetFieldName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the target field in the document template.
This is the placeholder name in the document template that will be populated with the source value.
Example: "FirstName", "ApprovalDate", "Amount".

DataSourceType.description:
Specifies the type of data source, determining how data is fetched and processed.
JSON serialized as string values. Used to classify data sources and route to appropriate executors.
